move: Patch PHP2Shell exposure across studio surfaces
mechanism: A known AI-discovered PHP RCE class left unpatched is uncapped downside for a studio selling agent trust; the advisory was 2 days old at capture
falsifier: Inventory shows no PHP deployments and no WAF-covered surfaces; close as not-applicable
first_step: Inventory PHP and legacy surfaces, apply the php.net 2026-10-21 advisory and Cloudflare WAF guidance

move: Trial classifier gating on fleet cron loops
mechanism: Routing cheap decisions off frontier models cuts per-routine API cost (creator-shown: 4,451 routings for 18 cents [unverified]); savings compound with every cron job the fleet adds
falsifier: A 2-week A/B where gated loops cost more than always-LLM routing once misroute rework is counted
first_step: Wrap the nightly digest cron's classification steps behind a Jev-style JSON classifier and log both costs

mechanism: One prompt-injected agent with a full-access key can move money or delete data; AI phishing now matches expert efficacy at ~4 cents/email, so injection is when-not-if
falsifier: Audit finds no agent can reach keys that spend, send, or delete; document and stand down
first_step: List every credential an agent can touch; replace with read-only DB users, scoped expiring keys, or a local MCP proxy

move: Add a business KB-agent offer beside SOP-to-skills
mechanism: Same buyer as the SOP wedge (owner-bottleneck service businesses), adjacent pain; price anchors to the replaced employee's salary, not build hours, raising deal size on identical delivery machinery
falsifier: 10 qualified calls yield zero deposits at the 20-40k anchor; reprice or kill
first_step: One-page offer plus a mock-data 15-minute demo build; book the first 5 calls from the existing network

move: Ship one proactive out-of-loop demo agent (signal curator)
mechanism: A public hype/fact/signal curator is a compounding attention asset and the live proof for proactive-agent retainers; sweeps run for pennies, so demo cost is near zero
falsifier: After 30 days it needs over ~15 min/week of upkeep, or zero agents count as doing useful work; the proactive pitch is not sellable yet
first_step: Stand up the pi-durable-news-agent pattern on the always-on box: cron sweep, dedupe, Jev-style rank, 7 cards per tick

move: Make fan-out evals standard on client deliverables
mechanism: One brief fanned across three models and cherry-picked buys output quality at the same prompt cost, protecting margin on fixed-price work
falsifier: Across 10 trials, fan-out selections add no win-rate lift over single-model output; drop the step
first_step: Run the next forge card's brief through three models and log which pieces get picked and why

move: Install the software-factory loop as the studio's default delivery method
mechanism: Grill intent up front, split each release into issues, let agents run plan-implement-validate, review output once in staging; the studio harness doubles as the client demo
falsifier: Batch-reviewed autonomous loops need more rework than interactive sessions across 3 consecutive forge releases
first_step: Run the next forge release through grill-plan-implement-validate with one daily batch review

move: Ship card-level spend rails in every client install
mechanism: One virtual card per deployed agent with hard limits on the card (weekly cap, category lock, expiry) plus a webhook on every charge; prompts are not enforcement
falsifier: A month of live agents with zero webhook hits and zero cap rejections, or one runaway charge the card failed to stop
first_step: Issue one capped virtual card to the studio's own cron fleet and wire the charge webhook

move: Convert every recurring workflow into a forkable playbook repo
mechanism: Each client workflow ships as a GitHub repo with readme, system prompt, examples, and evals; chat threads are disposable, repos survive compaction and are client-editable IP
falsifier: Shipped repos are never forked or modified by us or the client within 90 days of delivery
first_step: Backfill the top 3 studio workflows (SOP-to-skills, monitoring, distillation) into repo form

move: Adopt batch check-in cadence for all agent streams
mechanism: About once a day per stream instead of continuous monitoring; reinvest the recovered attention into harness rules and skills rather than more parallel sessions
falsifier: A defect sits unseen for over 24 hours and the rework cost exceeds the focus time saved
first_step: Set completion pings plus one fixed daily review slot for the cron fleet; no mid-day peeking for a week

move: Add a face-and-voice layer to defended studio channels
mechanism: Slop is the differentiator problem: real face and voice protect channel momentum against AI-slop flags while competitors ship copy-paste output
falsifier: Over 15 packaged videos, face-and-voice content underperforms anonymous equivalents on watch time, shares, and saves
first_step: Record one real-face intro for the highest-velocity channel and A/B it against the current packaging

move: Hold the one-feature product wedge for studio-built apps
mechanism: Single input to structured output through one API; each added feature multiplies maintenance cost roughly 10x, so feature two ships only after feature one has paying-user evidence
falsifier: Any second feature ships before the first retains paying users
first_step: Audit the app backlog: cut or defer every feature that is not the single core conversion
